node.label: Environment & Ecology
node.summary: Pollution, climate, wildlife, dams and environmental law.

facts.text: Amazon deforestation data (2010-24): mining area up **272%**, pasture area up **19%**, soybean plantations up **193%**; dry-season rainfall fell **17%** (1979-2018). A separate Indian study projects the country's vegetation carbon storage could nearly **double (97%)** by 2100, chiefly in Rajasthan, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh.
facts.plain: Amazon deforestation data (2010-24): mining area up 272%, pasture area up 19%, soybean plantations up 193%; dry-season rainfall fell 17% (1979-2018). A separate Indian study projects the country's vegetation carbon storage could nearly double (97%) by 2100, chiefly in Rajasthan, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh.

facts.text: A *Nature* study (airborne CO2 readings, 2010-2024, lead author **Luciana Vanni Gatti**) found the **Amazon rainforest is now a net carbon source, not a sink**: wildfires caused it to emit **1.17 billion tonnes** more carbon than it absorbed; in the El Niño year **2024**, **38%** of deforestation was fire-caused.
facts.plain: A Nature study (airborne CO2 readings, 2010-2024, lead author Luciana Vanni Gatti) found the Amazon rainforest is now a net carbon source, not a sink: wildfires caused it to emit 1.17 billion tonnes more carbon than it absorbed; in the El Niño year 2024, 38% of deforestation was fire-caused.
keys: Amazon rainforest is now a net carbon source, not a sink

facts.text: The **Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)** in NCR issued show-cause notices to Senior Superintendents of Police and Deputy Commissioners of **five Punjab districts** for not complying with its stubble-burning orders.

facts.text: Delhi's 24-hour AQI rose to **377** ('very poor') on 5 Nov, up from **350**; stubble burning's share in Delhi's PM2.5 **doubled from 8.2% to 16.28%** between Tuesday and Wednesday, per the Union Ministry of Earth Sciences.

facts.text: **CSIR-NEERI**'s green crackers emit about **30% less particulate matter**. Types: **SWAS** (water releaser), **STAR** (thermite-based) and **SAFAL** (minimal aluminium); packs carry the CSIR-NEERI logo and a QR code.

facts.text: **COP30** was held at **Belém, Brazil (2025)**; **COP29** at **Baku, Azerbaijan (2024)**; COP28 at Dubai (2023).
facts.plain: COP30 was held at Belém, Brazil (2025); COP29 at Baku, Azerbaijan (2024); COP28 at Dubai (2023).

facts.text: **COP31** will be held in **Antalya, Türkiye**, on **9-20 Nov 2026**. Environment Minister **Bhupender Yadav** said India will seek a **Climate Finance Work Programme**, predictable public finance under **Article 9.1 of the Paris Agreement**, and continuation of the Just Transition Work Programme, and will oppose new top-down mitigation targets.
facts.plain: COP31 will be held in Antalya, Türkiye, on 9-20 Nov 2026. Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav said India will seek a Climate Finance Work Programme, predictable public finance under Article 9.1 of the Paris Agreement, and continuation of the Just Transition Work Programme, and will oppose new top-down mitigation targets.

facts.text: **Buxa Tiger Reserve** is in **Alipurduar** district, West Bengal; **Valmiki Tiger Reserve** is in **West Champaran**, Bihar's only tiger reserve.
facts.plain: Buxa Tiger Reserve is in Alipurduar district, West Bengal; Valmiki Tiger Reserve is in West Champaran, Bihar's only tiger reserve.

facts.text: Tigress **'Dooars Rani'**, moved from Bihar's **Valmiki Tiger Reserve** to **Buxa Tiger Reserve** on 2 Oct (West Bengal's first tiger relocation), strayed into Assam's **Raimona National Park** and was captured and brought back. WB Forest Minister: Manoj Oraon.

facts.text: Editorial: national need doesn't excuse bypassing laws and local consent. Most of the Brahmaputra's flow comes from monsoon rain and downstream tributaries, not Tibet.

facts.text: **Siang Upper Multipurpose Project** (Arunachal Pradesh), planned at **11.2 GW**, is India's answer to China's **60 GW** dam on the **Yarlung Tsangpo**, which becomes the **Brahmaputra** in India.
facts.plain: Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (Arunachal Pradesh), planned at 11.2 GW, is India's answer to China's 60 GW dam on the Yarlung Tsangpo, which becomes the Brahmaputra in India.

facts.text: GRAP is reactive. Lasting fixes need year-round controls on vehicles, dust, industry and crop-residue burning across the airshed.

facts.text: **GRAP** (Graded Response Action Plan) has **four stages** of emergency measures and is run by the **Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)**.
facts.plain: GRAP (Graded Response Action Plan) has four stages of emergency measures and is run by the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM).

facts.text: CAQM invoked **GRAP Stage 2** as Delhi's AQI hit **324** ('very poor'): higher parking fees, staggered office hours, extra Metro trips.
facts.plain: CAQM invoked GRAP Stage 2 as Delhi's AQI hit 324 ('very poor'): higher parking fees, staggered office hours, extra Metro trips.

facts.text: Delhi's winter entry curbs on non-BS-VI, non-Delhi-registered vehicles began Sunday and run till 31 January; on Day 1, police checked 7,279 vehicles, turned back 714 non-destined vehicles and impounded 38 end-of-life vehicles.
facts.plain: Delhi's winter entry curbs on non-BS-VI, non-Delhi-registered vehicles began Sunday and run till 31 January; on Day 1, police checked 7,279 vehicles, turned back 714 non-destined vehicles and impounded 38 end-of-life vehicles.

facts.text: India's urban population is about **36%** (Telangana about **48%**). Greener States (**Kerala, Goa, Puducherry**) have infant mortality around **8 per 1,000**, against about **30** in **U.P. and Rajasthan**; green spaces are part of **AMRUT**. A PNAS study of 57 countries linked tree-canopy loss to child mortality.

Greener States (Kerala, Goa, Puducherry) have infant mortality around 8 per 1,000, against about 30 in U.P. and Rajasthan; green spaces are part of AMRUT. A PNAS study of 57 countries linked tree-canopy loss to child mortality.

facts.text: The **Cauvery Water Disputes Tribunal** gave its award in **2007**; the SC modified it in **2018** and the **Cauvery Water Management Authority** was set up. Inter-State river disputes fall under **Article 262**.
facts.plain: The Cauvery Water Disputes Tribunal gave its award in 2007; the SC modified it in 2018 and the Cauvery Water Management Authority was set up. Inter-State river disputes fall under Article 262.

facts.text: Karnataka CM **D.K. Shivakumar** said **2,500 acres** were identified as alternative land for the **Mekedatu** balancing reservoir on the **Cauvery** near **Kanakapura** (Bengaluru South district): **66 tmc** storage, **400 MW** power, drinking water for Bengaluru. **Tamil Nadu** opposes it.

facts.text: Types of APCDs: **bag filters** (fabric), **electrostatic precipitators** (high-voltage charge), **cyclone separators** (centrifugal force) and **scrubbers** (liquids).
facts.plain: Types of APCDs: bag filters (fabric), electrostatic precipitators (high-voltage charge), cyclone separators (centrifugal force) and scrubbers (liquids).

facts.text: **CPCB** (letter of 30 Oct) told Delhi and the Haryana, U.P. and Rajasthan pollution boards to shut NCR industries that have not ordered **air pollution control devices (APCDs)**. CAQM's limit of **50 mg/Nm3** of particulate matter for **17 highly polluting** industry categories applied from **1 Oct**; only about **200 of 2,321** units had complied by 31 July.
facts.plain: CPCB (letter of 30 Oct) told Delhi and the Haryana, U.P. and Rajasthan pollution boards to shut NCR industries that have not ordered air pollution control devices (APCDs). facts.text: Under the Delhi notification, vehicles without a valid **Pollution Under Control (PUC)** certificate will not get fuel at petrol pumps throughout the year; enforcement uses ANPR cameras and an AI-enabled Integrated Command and Control Centre.
facts.plain: Under the Delhi notification, vehicles without a valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate will not get fuel at petrol pumps throughout the year; enforcement uses ANPR cameras and an AI-enabled Integrated Command and Control Centre.

facts.text: Delhi's winter air plan began on **1 Nov**: ban on dust-generating demolition and outdoor construction, no entry for non-Delhi vehicles below **BS-VI**, **50% work from home**, all till **31 Jan**; **double parking charges** and staggered office hours (Delhi govt 10 am-6.30 pm, MCD 8.30 am-5 pm) till **28 Feb**. It rests on a gazette notification of **23 June**; Environment Minister **Manjinder Singh Sirsa**.
facts.plain: Delhi's winter air plan began on 1 Nov: ban on dust-generating demolition and outdoor construction, no entry for non-Delhi vehicles below BS-VI, 50% work from home, all till 31 Jan; double parking charges and staggered office hours (Delhi govt 10 am-6.30 pm, MCD 8.30 am-5 pm) till 28 Feb. It rests on a gazette notification of 23 June; Environment Minister Manjinder Singh Sirsa.

facts.text: Punjab farm fires nearly doubled in a week to **1,007** (194 in one day on 29 Oct); **Tarn Taran** (397), **Amritsar** (171) and **Ferozepur** (104) lead; 246 FIRs registered and ₹17 lakh in fines imposed.

facts.text: CAQM's new **Integrated Command and Control Centre** links data from **111 CAAQMS** monitoring stations, 2,300+ industries and 3,200+ construction sites in Delhi-NCR.
facts.plain: CAQM's new Integrated Command and Control Centre links data from 111 CAAQMS monitoring stations, 2,300+ industries and 3,200+ construction sites in Delhi-NCR.

facts.text: CAQM banned **construction and demolition** in Delhi-NCR from **5 to 20 Nov** (exempting railways, metro, airports, ISBTs, hospitals, defence) and ordered **50% work from home** for offices in Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Sonipat, Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddha Nagar; Union Environment Minister **Bhupender Yadav** announced it. Deepavali falls on **8 Nov**.

facts.text: A tigress (**BTRTF-1/T-138**) moved from Bihar to West Bengal's **Buxa Tiger Reserve** on 2 Oct crossed the **Sankosh** river into Assam's **Raimona National Park**; NTCA is tracking it by radio collar. Buxa became a tiger reserve in **1983** but had no resident tigers for years.

facts.text: Eight panchayats in **Kasaragod** (Keralam) will revive **surangams**, traditional horizontal water tunnels dug into **laterite** hills, using workers under the **VB-G RAM G** rural jobs scheme.

facts.text: West Bengal cracker rules: decibel limit **125 dB** for sound-emitting and **90 dB** for light-emitting crackers; only green crackers; bursting allowed **8-10 p.m.** on Deepavali and **6-8 a.m.** on Chhath; sky lanterns need fire department permission. DGP: **Siddhi Nath Gupta**.

facts.text: Delhi, U.P., Haryana, Rajasthan and Punjab have implemented only **40-60%** of the anti-pollution annual action plans they filed with the **CAQM**; **Rajasthan** was the worst performer and **U.P.** the best. Punjab's plan covers only stubble burning. Delhi's AQI was 229 ('poor').

facts.text: Protests also hit the **1,605-MW Subansiri Upper Hydroelectric Project** (also called **Menga Dam**) in Upper Subansiri district, with violence in its HQ **Daporijo** during a 12-hour shutdown.

facts.text: A rally in **Itanagar** demanded release of 30+ people detained after violent protests on 23-24 Oct against the **11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project**; mobs had burnt an **NHPC** office. The Siang meets the **Dibang** and **Lohit** to form the **Brahmaputra** in Assam.
